subsection.title: Validation Hypothesis
subsection.description: State the outcome hypothesis the mockup or PoC must test for the confirmed Primary Persona.
subsection.example: If product managers can shape an idea through guided questions, they can reach a reviewable PoC without first writing a full specification.

subsection.title: In-Scope Features
subsection.description: - List every Feature included in the PoC with a unique ID: F1, F2, and so on. - Give each Feature a user-oriented name and one observable result. - State which core ideal use case intent each Feature supports. - Section 4 must describe exactly this Feature set.
subsection.example: | ID | Feature | Core ideal use case intent | Observable result | |----|---------|----------------------------|-------------------| | F1 | Guided idea capture | Turn a rough idea into a clear product direction | The product manager sees a complete product overview | | F2 | PoC preview | Verify the intended user journey before implementation | The product manager can review the ideal journey |

subsection.title: Out of Scope
subsection.description: Optional. List only exclusions the user explicitly wants the PoC boundary to show. Do not invent non-goals to complete this subsection.

subsection.title: Success Criteria
subsection.description: - Define one to three observable results that distinguish a successful PoC. - Preserve user-provided values and units exactly. - Do not invent targets the user did not supply.
